issues.title: Connect Canvas to the single Server owner through typed AEDS v2
issues.body:
Refs #2482, #2483, #2484, #2485.

Actual gap: current Server document store/operation engine/coordinate authority exists; runtime endpoint and frontend binary transport do not. Required scope is one shared contract owner, existing domain validation/hash/CAS/history/request-id semantics, bounded typed request/reply frames, POD/C++/TypeScript parity and real Server-session authorization. Preserve current AEDS-v2-only, X-Fsus headers, unified response/errors, PoW/privacy/fail-closed protections. Do not introduce JSON fallback or browser authority.

Acceptance: independent concrete domain/wire design review; all actually required endpoints and response/request codec/ABI/generator/OpenAPI/typed error mappings implemented and verified; original and new boundary/refusal tests; true storage/CAS/provider/session lifecycle checks and mandatory canonical CI. Actor/owner derives from actual session, document/nodes/resolver cannot escape current site/permission bounds. Page reads bind revision/content/history identity.

WIP: concrete bounded design proposes13 new frames253-265, pending source/design review and actual verification. No public route activation, production deployment or parent closure on design/static results.
